# Welcome {-}

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

Welcome to the **ForestPlots.net Training Manual**. This is a practical guide for people working with data on [ForestPlots.net](https://forestplots.net) — the global network for monitoring tropical forest plots across the tropics.

This manual is used alongside training sessions with the ForestPlots team. If you have been directed here, your ForestPlots contact will point you to the chapter relevant to your current task. See the **Before you start** chapter for an overview of what is currently covered.

## About ForestPlots.net {-}

ForestPlots.net is a pan-tropical network and database hosting long-term forest inventory data from permanent sample plots across the tropics. It supports research into forest dynamics, carbon stocks, and ecosystem responses to climate change.
